vulnerability.name: USN-8055-2
vulnerability.description: USN-8055-1 fixed a vulnerability in Evolution Data Server. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 18.04 LTS and Ubuntu 20.04 LTS.  Original advisory details:   It was discovered that Evolution Data Server incorrectly handled  removing local cache files. An attacker could possibly use this issue  to cause Evolution Data Server to remove arbitrary files.

statements.status_notes: Evolution Data Server could be made to remove files. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
